name: Lukas Geyer
tagline: Semestra, Paradeiser and Muninn: calm, private apps for studying, built by Lukas Geyer.
headline: Calm, private apps that help you study.
intro: Semestra plans your study time around your lectures, Paradeiser keeps you focused in intervals, and Muninn will help you remember. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

semestra.name: Semestra
semestra.subtitle: Study Planner for iPhone & iPad
semestra.summary: Semestra turns your university timetable into a study plan: it finds the free time between your lectures, spreads the study time for each exam until exam day, and adjusts by itself when something moves.
semestra.pricing: Free · Semestra Plus arrives with version 2.0

tile_shot.alt: Semestra's plan: study blocks placed between lectures

features.title: Timetable in, plan out
features.text: Subscribe to the calendar link from your university portal or import an .ics file. Semestra finds the free time in your week and plans your study blocks into it.

shots.alt: Semestra's plan: study blocks placed between lectures

features.title: Exams, detected
features.text: Exams in your timetable are recognised and added with one tap, each with its study hours, preparation time and priority.

features.title: A plan that keeps up
features.text: When a lecture or an exam moves, the plan adjusts by itself. Finish, move or skip a block and it recalculates.

features.title: Always in view
features.text: A reminder before each block, and the running block on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

features.title: Works with your calendar
features.text: Your appointments stay free, and study blocks can go into a calendar of their own.

features.title: Coming with 2.0
features.text: A guided setup, a week view, registration deadlines, widgets, Semestra Plus and the link with Paradeiser. See the changelog below.

shots.alt: Semestra's week view with lectures and study blocks
Semestra's statistics with progress, streak and milestones

paradeiser.name: Paradeiser
paradeiser.subtitle: Interval Focus Timer for iPhone & iPad
paradeiser.summary: Paradeiser is a calm interval timer for focused study and work: set your focus blocks and breaks, follow along on the Lock Screen, and grow a tomato for every round you finish.

tile_shot.alt: Paradeiser's timer with a focus interval under way

features.title: Your own intervals
features.text: Any combination of focus blocks and breaks, such as three 45-minute blocks with 15-minute breaks, saved as presets you switch with one tap.

shots.alt: Paradeiser's timer with a focus interval under way

features.title: Keeps running
features.text: The timer follows the clock, so it stays right when the app is closed or the iPhone is locked.

features.title: Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
features.text: The running interval as a Live Activity, with buttons to pause, resume and skip.

features.title: Works with Semestra
features.text: Paradeiser suggests focus and break times for your next study block, and the time counts as studied in your plan.

features.title: Tomatoes and streaks
features.text: With Paradeiser Plus, every focus round earns tomatoes, days in a row build a streak, and Rest Days protect it.

shots.alt: Paradeiser's Tomato Market with Rest Days

features.title: Statistics
features.text: With Plus: focus time per day and week, focus tags, a daily goal, and logging to Apple Calendar and Apple Health.

shots.alt: Paradeiser's statistics with the harvest basket

muninn.name: Muninn
muninn.subtitle: Spaced-Repetition Flashcards Built on Rust & FSRS-7
muninn.summary: A spaced-repetition flashcard app as capable as Anki without being a clone of it: one shared Rust core with an FSRS-7 scheduler and lossless Anki deck import, wrapped in fast native apps starting with iOS and macOS.
muninn.platforms: iOS · macOS first · Android and desktop planned
muninn.pricing: Free on every platform · Optional Plus tier

features.title: One shared core
features.text: A single Rust core holds the collection model, the scheduling and the file format, so every platform behaves the same.

features.title: FSRS-7 scheduling
features.text: A modern spaced-repetition scheduler tuned for long-term retention, without settings to babysit.

features.title: Anki decks welcome
features.text: Existing Anki decks are imported into clean native card types, keeping their templates so they can go back to Anki unchanged.

features.title: Native apps
features.text: No web wrappers: iOS and macOS first from one SwiftUI codebase, then Android, Windows and Linux.
